Faculty are receiving-side profiles, never automatically a placement-cohort denominator. Current titles do not imply first job, tenure-track status, or employment start; CV present entries do not prove continuous employment to the check date. Exact linked individual URLs or explicit multi-source doctoral/employer identity evidence are required for placement association.
